title: A vanishing diagonal integral on an orbit-covering set forces a cusp form to vanish
statement: Let Δ be any subgroup of SL₂(ℤ), viewed in GL₂(ℝ) by the canonical embedding, and let μ=dx dy/y² on ℍ. Let E⊂ℍ be measurable and suppose that for μ-almost every z there is γ∈Δ with γz∈E. Let f∈CuspForm Δ 2 and put P(f,f)(z)=conjugate(f(z))f(z)(Im z)². If P(f,f) is μ-integrable on E and ∫_E P(f,f)dμ=0, then f=0.
lean_statement: ∀ (Δ : Subgroup (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ)) (E : Set UpperHalfPlane), MeasurableSet E → (∀ᵐ z ∂(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane), ∃ γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, γ ∈ Δ ∧ γ • z ∈ E) → ∀ f : CuspForm Δ 2, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (UpperHalfPlane.petersson 2 f f) E (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane) → MeasureTheory.integral ((MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane).restrict E) (UpperHalfPlane.petersson 2 f f) = 0 → f = 0
